PROOF_RESULT_SCHEMA.description: One observed proof result. binding distinguishes native-case observations from aggregate-run bindings; attempts must report facts only.

target.description: Ecosystem-neutral execution target (browser, runtime, database, device, deployment, or default).

PROOF_RUN_ARTIFACT_SCHEMA.description: Producer-emitted kibi.proof-run.v1 proof artifact. Producers report what happened; Kibi evaluates proof obligations and policies. Produce it via `kibi prove` or direct kb_ingest_proof calls.

items.description: One observed proof result. binding distinguishes native-case observations from aggregate-run bindings; attempts must report facts only.

target.description: Ecosystem-neutral execution target (browser, runtime, database, device, deployment, or default).

certificates.description: kibi.code-certificate.v1 objects the run left for certificate-kind contracts, one per test. Kibi re-checks each before a receipt counts as proved.

PROOF_CONTRACT_SCHEMA.description: Semantic proof contract binding a test to explicit proof obligations executed by a configured integration.

kind.description: What the checker establishes; absent means e2e. exhaustive, typecheck, arithmetic, smt, rule, state_machine and regex must leave a kibi.code-certificate.v1 that Kibi re-checks before the receipt counts as proved. source reads the contract's source itself: the run may leave {version, kind: source, test_id, source} or nothing, and Kibi stores its own read as the certificate.

source.description: source: the project source a source proof reads. A project source Kibi reads by itself. reader json or yaml: {file, path?, select?: keys|values|items}. glob: {pattern, capture?, ignore?} (capture true reads what each * matched). openapi: {file, select?: operations|unsecured_operations|security_schemes|responses}. references: {files, extract: env|imports|calls|string_args|thrown|property, callee?, key?, ignore?} over TypeScript, JavaScript, Python and SWI-Prolog files. schema: {format: drizzle|prisma|sql, file (drizzle, prisma) or files (sql migrations), exports?, table?, select?: tables|columns|required_columns|nullable_columns|foreign_keys}. routes: {file, export, framework?: hono|express, path_prefix?, names_from?, select?: routes|middleware}. validator: {file, export, select?: fields|required_fields|optional_fields}. prolog: {file, functor: Name/Arity, arg?} reads one argument of every fact with that functor in a SWI-Prolog file (requires/1 in pack.pl), without running it. Paths are repository-relative. A member Kibi cannot read statically fails the read with its location.

domain_source.description: exhaustive and typecheck: the symbol that defines the finite domain (typecheck: also the type whose fields a required_fields fact names). state_machine: the transition table or next-state function. The proof must import it from its source file; a hand-listed domain downgrades the receipt to example. Kibi reads the export named `export`, or the symbol's title when `export` is absent.

export.description: The name the domain is exported under in the symbol's source file, when the symbol's title is not that name.

field.description: exhaustive: when the export is a list of records, the field of each record that names a domain member (a catalog's name).

arg.description: A SWI-Prolog predicate's argument (1-based) whose solutions Kibi reads, when the predicate takes more than one argument (operator/2 with arg 1 lists each operator's name).

witness.description: typecheck: the repository-relative witness file Kibi compiles (an exhaustive switch ending in never, or a mapped type over the domain).

proves.description: Certificate kinds: the requirement claim keys (CLAIM-...) this certificate proves. Each must be a modeled claim of a current requirement the test reaches through its scenarios. Kibi derives what the certificate must establish from the claim's grounding fact (a set fact for exhaustive or typecheck, a numeric fact for arithmetic or smt, a rule, predicate or set fact for rule and state_machine, a string fact for regex); a claim with no such derivation is only attested and never counts as proved.

value_source.description: arithmetic and smt: code constants the assumptions read. Kibi evaluates each export at ingest and requires the certificate to assume the variable equals that value, so the proof is about the code and not only the knowledge base. With measure count the value is the size of a list, set, map or object export, so a count claim reads the collection itself. A dotted export (POLICY.eventLimit) reads one field of an object export. An entry {source, measure: count} counts the members Kibi reads from a project source (routes, tables, environment variables).

arg.description: A SWI-Prolog predicate's argument (1-based) whose solutions Kibi reads, when the predicate takes more than one argument (operator/2 with arg 1 lists each operator's name).

Paths are repository-relative. A member Kibi cannot read statically fails the read with its location.

measure.description: value (default for an export): the export is a number. count (the only measure of a source): the number of members of a list, set, map or object export, or of a source.

predicate_source.description: rule: the code function behind each predicate a claim's rule, predicate or set fact names, keyed by predicate name. Each export takes the predicate's arguments in order and returns a boolean; Kibi calls it on every combination of its argument domains.

export.description: The exported function's name in the symbol's source file. Without it Kibi reads the export named by the symbol's title.

harness_for.description: The predicate is a test harness that decides the predicate by driving these code symbols (for example by calling the handler with each role). The symbols must be covered_by the test; a claim the harness proves is bound with scope harness.

domains.description: rule: the finite domain of each argument type, keyed by type name (an array, Set, Map or object export, or a Python list, set, dict or Enum), or {source} for the members Kibi reads from a project source (every route, every table, every environment variable). state_machine with a next-state function: the `state` and `event` domains it is called on.

arg.description: A SWI-Prolog predicate's argument (1-based) whose solutions Kibi reads, when the predicate takes more than one argument (operator/2 with arg 1 lists each operator's name).

initial_source.description: state_machine: the export holding the initial state (or states), needed for initial_states and reachable_states facts.

arg.description: A SWI-Prolog predicate's argument (1-based) whose solutions Kibi reads, when the predicate takes more than one argument (operator/2 with arg 1 lists each operator's name).

pattern_source.description: regex: the export holding the code's pattern (a RegExp, or a Python re.Pattern) or string constant that a string fact is about.

constraint_source.description: arithmetic and smt: the typed numeric property_value facts the certificate's assumptions come from. Kibi checks the assumptions (or the query's assertions) are exactly these facts' constraints, so the proof is about the knowledge base, not numbers the test chose.

PROOF_BINDINGS_SCHEMA.description: Optional native-runner bindings for proof obligations. Bindings are provenance metadata; they never replace the semantic proof contract.
